name: Trotro
description: Shared minibuses that operate on set routes. They are widely used and usually inexpensive. Ask the mate or driver to confirm the destination before boarding.
tip: Carry small Ghana cedi notes and coins where possible.

name: Metro Mass Transit and intercity buses
description: Bus services connect some towns and cities. Private coach operators also serve major intercity routes.
tip: Check the operator's current timetable, departure station and luggage rules.

name: STC and other coach services
description: Long-distance coach services operate on selected routes between major towns and cities.
tip: Book ahead for busy travel periods and confirm the departure terminal.

name: Taxis
description: Taxis are available in cities and towns. Some are shared while others are hired privately.
tip: Agree on the fare before starting a trip if the taxi is not using a meter.

name: Ride-hailing apps
description: App-based services such as Yango and Bolt operate in some Ghanaian cities. Availability varies by location.
tip: Check the vehicle, driver and fare details in the app before travelling.

name: Motorcycles and tricycles
description: Okada motorcycles and tricycles are used for local transport in some areas. Rules and availability vary.
tip: Use a helmet and check local regulations and safety conditions.

name: Domestic flights
description: Domestic air services can reduce travel time between selected destinations when routes are operating.
tip: Check current routes, schedules, baggage limits and airport details directly with the airline.

name: Rail
description: Passenger rail services are limited to selected corridors and may not be useful for every journey.
tip: Check current operations before planning a trip around rail travel.

name: Ferries and boats
description: Boats and ferries serve some communities and routes around Lake Volta and other waterways.
tip: Use authorised operators and follow life-jacket and safety instructions.

name: Car rental and private drivers
description: Visitors can arrange self-drive rentals or hire a driver for day trips and longer journeys.
tip: Confirm insurance, vehicle condition, driver arrangements and total costs in writing.
